why.title: When a single-brand plan stops being enough.
why.description: Enterprise is for teams that need one account across brands, stores and security reviews, rather than another self-serve seat.
paragraphs: Dominate runs the full loop for one store. Enterprise puts every store in one account, opens API and MCP access for your own tools, and puts a founder on the account with a direct line to engineering.
The decision usually shows up when catalog size, brand count, or procurement requirements outgrow a flat monthly plan.

faqSection.title: Enterprise FAQ
faqSection.description: Common questions about Enterprise plans, security, and onboarding.

items.question: When should I choose Enterprise over Dominate?
items.answer: Choose Enterprise when you run thousands of SKUs across several brands or stores, need a DPA or a security review, or want API access and a founder on your account. Dominate covers the full optimization loop for a single store up to 1000 products.

items.question: What does onboarding look like for Enterprise?
items.answer: We start with a short discovery call, share a custom ROI estimate for your catalog size, and scope an onboarding timeline. No procurement deck is required to begin the conversation.

items.question: Is SOC 2 available today?
items.answer: Not yet. SOC 2 is on our roadmap, timed to customer security reviews. We'll answer your security questionnaire and sign a DPA now.

items.question: Can Enterprise connect to our existing data stack?
items.answer: Partly, today. The REST API, the MCP server and the CLI connect stores, report onboarding status and manage API keys. If your team needs scan results in its own tools, tell us on the call and we'll scope it.
